explanation: I found no Mathlib converse of this statement. Mathlib's `Scheme.Modules.exists_isOpenCover_presentation` in AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Tilde.lean goes the other way: it takes quasicoherence and produces presentations of the restrictions on an open cover. `SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop` in Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/Quasicoherent.lean is the closest ingredient, but it needs quasicoherence of `M.over (U i)`. Getting that from presentations of `M.restrict (U i).ι` is the library's own step, `presentationOverOfPresentationRestrict`, and Mathlib has no such lemma. The derivation would also need the cover-to-`CoversTop` translation, so it is more than a one- or two-line instantiation. I grepped Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for `IsQuasicoherent` and for presentation-related lemmas and found no matching declaration.
